fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2025-10-04 states that the complainant reported that a boundary wall near Selvapuram Puram Main Street was extended into the land of the complainant without permission, on 2025-10-03 around 09:40 hrs. The complainant, Harish Subramani, provided the contact number 9000000398. Kishore Selvam (9000000323) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint refers to Nandha Karuppasamy, a neighbour, reachable on 9000000113. The complainant alleged that Karthik Rajan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000091. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Encroachment reportedly began after a dispute over survey records.
fields.Keywords: land encroachment, boundary dispute, morning, associate, witness, main street, suspect, mobile number
